test_title: PYST 43 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: One of these words is spelled incorrectly. Which one is it?
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Concious is spelled incorrectly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Concious** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **Conscious**.
 
• The other words, **Government**, **Embellish**, and **Perceive**, are spelled correctly.
 
• This question tests your ability to identify misspelled words among a list of options.

Correct sentence: *One of these words is spelled incorrectly. The correct word is **Conscious**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tips for identifying spelling errors:**

 
 
• Pay attention to commonly misspelled words, such as "Conscious," "Separate," and "Definite."
 
• Look for subtle differences in spelling, especially with vowels and consonant placement.
 
 
 
• **Mnemonic for Conscious:** *"Be conscious of your spelling, as it has 'sci' in it."*
